description: A client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that provides visual command suggestions for mute commands, just like native Minecraft commands! Perfect for server administrators and moderators who want to streamline their moderation workflow.

mods.name: Mute Assist
mods.description: A client-side Fabric mod that provides intelligent, context-aware suggestions for the /mute command in Minecraft. Features smart tab completion for player names, durations, and Turkish mute reasons.

releases.notes:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ahasdemir/mute-assist/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.3

- Updated default reason-duration mappings with better Turkish phrases
- Fixed deprecated GitHub Actions (upload-artifact v3 → v4)
- Improved release automation system
- Enhanced configuration system stability
- Better Turkish language support for server moderation"

releases.notes:
- Add detailed usage instructions for both singleplayer and multiplayer
- Clarify that direct commands (/mf, /m, /tm, /um) work in multiplayer
- Explain helper commands (/mfhelp, /mutehelp, etc.) for better tab completion
- Update README with multiplayer-specific usage examples
- Clean up client initialization code

The /mf command works in multiplayer but may not show tab completion.
Users can type commands directly or use helper commands for suggestions.
